context: A uni intern interviews a manager about lobby dynamics
purpose: Teach: 多用/却下/零細/撤廃/利権/啓蒙/弾力/類型

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 取材で恐縮ですが、業界内の利権構造、ここ十年でどう変わってきましたか。
lines.en: I apologize for taking your time, but I'd like to ask — how has the vested-interest structure in your industry changed over the past decade?
lines.style: Respectful, carefully prepared. Slight nervous energy at the beginning. Measured pace, not rushed. Genuine curiosity underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 類型的な囲い込みは、弾力的な業界連携に少しずつ変わってきています。
lines.en: The typical kind of closed-off patterns have gradually shifted toward more flexible industry cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact delivery. Speaking from experience without performing expertise. Steady eye contact. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一部の規制撤廃が後押しになった、ということですか。
lines.en: So regulatory changes helped push that along?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Testing her answer. Engaged and thinking out loud. Quick, attentive follow-up.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: その通り。ただ零細事業者からは、まだ啓蒙が足りないという声もあります。
lines.en: Exactly right. Though I do hear from smaller operators that there's still not enough education or outreach happening.
lines.style: Conceding and honest. Slight pause before the qualification. Not defensive — just being complete. Level tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界提案が却下される場面も、多用に経験されてきたんでしょうか。
lines.en: Have you seen a lot of industry proposals get turned down as well?
lines.style: Curious, open-ended. Inviting her to expand. Genuine interest in the specifics, not just checking boxes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 多用というか、ほぼ毎月のように一度は却下案件が出ますね。
lines.en: A lot? More like almost every month something gets rejected. It's pretty routine at this point.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh underneath. Candid tiredness mixed with the humor. Shrugging tone — this is just how it works.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。記事ではその辺りも踏まえて書きたいと思います。
lines.en: I see. I want to make sure I include that perspective in the piece.
lines.style: Earnest, taking notes mentally. Nodding slightly. Genuine respect for what she's sharing, not just extracting information.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。事実関係、確認したい箇所は事前に共有してください。
lines.en: That would help a lot. Send over any specific facts you want me to double-check before you publish, and we can go through them together.
lines.style: Professional and helpful. Settling into the practical next step. Warm underneath — she's genuinely trying to help him get it right.
